author: reek
body: Stage 5c: induction over a PARAMETRIC datatype. `app xs Nl === xs` over `Lst a` (a generic list). The induction variable's type `Lst a` resolves to an applied `ConstructedTy Lst [a]`, not a bare `SumTy`; the checker now resolves the head constructor to its variant definition (`sumty-of`), so the element type is irrelevant to the proof. The MyCons/Cn case is `cong ih` (N-ary peel), same as the concrete case.
